name: Keerthi Industries Limited
about: Keerthi Industries Limited engages in the manufacturing, sale, and distribution of cement in India, Malaysia, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Cement and Electronics. The company offers OPC and PPC cement under the Suvarna brand. It is also involved in manufacturing flexible and rigid printed circuit boards. The company was formerly known as Suvarna Cements Limited and changed its name to Keerthi Industries Limited in 2005. Keerthi Industries Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
